mode_note: Scoring prompt logprobs is one prefill; there is no decode phase to split on, so 'prefill_only' and 'decode_only' are a POSITIONAL split of the chunk at --boundary. prefill_only lets Engram act only on the context prefix (it shapes the KV the suffix attends to, but is shut at the point of prediction); decode_only shuts it over the prefix and opens it only on the scored tokens themselves. All four arms are scored on the same suffix tokens, so the numbers are directly comparable: prefill_only isolates Engram as a context builder, decode_only as a point-of-prediction lookup.
